relics.name: Zero Trust Roadmap
relics.desc: Battle start: a random asset gains a permanent +2 ward (all properties).
relics.lesson: A roadmap beats a product: start by protecting the assets that matter most.

relics.name: Managed Detection & Response
relics.desc: Each round start: reveal 1 hidden foothold with stealth up to 2.
relics.lesson: MDR gives smaller teams a 24×7 monitoring floor — but a floor is not a ceiling.

relics.name: Golden Image Pipeline
relics.desc: The first asset to go down each battle is rebuilt at 3 integrity.
relics.lesson: Rebuild from a known-good, signed image rather than cleaning a compromised host.

relics.name: Executive Sponsor
relics.lesson: Funding and air cover from the board are the control that makes the other controls possible.

relics.name: IR Runbooks
relics.desc: The first Respond card you play each round costs 1 less (never below 1).
relics.lesson: Rehearsed runbooks make the first ten minutes of an incident boringly fast.

relics.name: Threat Intel Feed
relics.desc: Each round start: +1 intel (see the adversary’s plans more clearly).
relics.lesson: Intelligence is only valuable when it changes what you do next.

relics.name: KEV Subscription
relics.desc: The adversary’s first Breach each battle has 1 less power.
relics.lesson: Patch what is known to be exploited first; CISA’s KEV catalogue is the shortlist.

relics.name: Penetration Test Report
relics.lesson: A good pen test report is a map of the adversary’s likeliest path.

relics.name: Bug Bounty Programme
relics.desc: Gain $1 each time a foothold is revealed.
relics.lesson: Pay researchers for finding flaws before adversaries do.

relics.name: 24×7 SOC
relics.lesson: Round-the-clock coverage widens what you can see and act on.

relics.name: Honeynet
relics.desc: Revealing a foothold also gives +1 Exposure.
relics.lesson: Deception turns every adversary mistake into a detection.

relics.name: Purple Team Budget
relics.desc: Draw a card each time you remove a foothold.
relics.lesson: Every eviction should teach you something to feed back into detections.

relics.name: SIEM Licence Uplift
relics.desc: All your monitors have +1 detection strength.
relics.lesson: Telemetry volume is a budget line; detection value comes from correlation.

relics.name: Crisis Communications Plan
relics.desc: Beacons drain 1 less Resilience each round.
relics.lesson: Calm, pre-agreed communications keep an incident from becoming a second incident.

relics.name: Cyber Range Training
relics.lesson: Teams that have rehearsed under pressure recover faster and make fewer errors.

relics.name: Change Freeze
relics.desc: Adversary Persistence, Stealth and Defense Impairment cards cost 1 more.
relics.lesson: Tight change control makes unauthorised change loud.

relics.name: Backup Vault Contract
relics.desc: Strike and Impair cards deal 1 less damage. Battle start: heal all assets 1.
relics.lesson: Tested, immutable backups are what turn a ransom demand into an inconvenience.

relics.name: Emergency Patch Fund
relics.lesson: Pre-approved emergency budget removes the argument from the first hour.

relics.name: Cyber Resilience Committee
relics.lesson: Resilience is governed: someone owns the impact tolerances and tests them.
